atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony. Citizens contribute in equal, individually apportioned shares; good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.
atoms.normalized_claim: The canonical premise states that at Home, the Colony is the crunch subject, Citizens contribute equal individually apportioned shares, and good stewardship creates a stable home enabling function, ambition, and ordinary life.

atoms.exact_source_text: What changed from the conventional production-grid model and from the earliest 0.4.7 draft
atoms.normalized_claim: The revision summary describes what changed from the conventional production-grid model and from the earliest 0.4.7 draft.

atoms.exact_source_text: Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole.
atoms.normalized_claim: Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories; Places support Practices, Citizens occupy Roles, and the colony succeeds as a whole.

atoms.exact_source_text: RTS production grid     | Colony posture
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior model of RTS production grid was reworked into a colony posture model.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.
atoms.normalized_claim: Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load.
atoms.normalized_claim: Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load.

atoms.exact_source_text: The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.
atoms.normalized_claim: The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.

atoms.exact_source_text: Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure.
atoms.normalized_claim: Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure.

atoms.exact_source_text: They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.
atoms.normalized_claim: Role shortfalls do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.

atoms.exact_source_text: A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure.
atoms.normalized_claim: A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure.

atoms.exact_source_text: The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.
atoms.normalized_claim: The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.

atoms.exact_source_text: Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space.
atoms.normalized_claim: Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space.

atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL).
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop is defined as the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL).

atoms.exact_source_text: It replaces the familiar base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop replaces the base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
